title: Please Let the Internet Die
summary: Online spaces are captured by oligarchs and saturated with slop—and they’re exacerbating humanity’s worst impulses. It’s time to start over.
llm_summary: The piece argues that the modern internet has been hijacked by a handful of powerful corporations and flooded with low‑quality, sensationalist content, which amplifies humanity’s worst instincts. Rather than trying to patch the broken system, the author contends we should consider a fresh start—re‑imagining online spaces from the ground up.
